title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: character of each document type and who may hold it
content:
## Scope

This quick reference for Bills of Lading and Transport Documents sets out, for every document type the line issues, the character of the document (how many originals a set carries and whether it is negotiable) and the admission terms tied to the type: the consignee form it allows, the customer roles that may hold it, eBL platform enrolment and an inland place of receipt.

## Tier table

| Document type | Originals per set | Negotiable by endorsement | Consignee TO ORDER or TO ORDER OF a bank allowed | Customer roles that may hold it | Documentation party must be enrolled on the eBL platform | Inland place of receipt or delivery allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | 0 | No | No | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | 1 (the single electronic record) | Yes | Yes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | Yes | No |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 3 | No | No | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 3 | Yes | Yes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | 3 | Yes | Yes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | Yes |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | 3 | Yes | Yes | freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No |

## Reading the table

- An originals count of 0 means the document is a waybill and no original document of title is put into circulation; a count of 1 is the single electronic record of an eBL; a count of 3 is a paper set of three originals.
- A negotiable document is a document of title transferable by endorsement. The AHL Sea Waybill and the AHL Straight Bill of Lading are not negotiable.
- An inland place of receipt, or a place of delivery different from the ports, is allowed only on the AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading.

## Points of judgement

**Can a beneficial cargo owner hold an AHL Switch Bill of Lading?** No. That tier admits only freight forwarders and NVOCCs; every other tier also admits the beneficial cargo owner.

**Which types carry three paper originals?** The AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable, AHL Combined Transport and AHL Switch Bills of Lading.

**Which type needs eBL platform enrolment?** Only the AHL Electronic Bill of Lading.
